fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ezreal''' fires a bolt of energy in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit, applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects and triggering {{tip|on-attack}} effects.
fields.description2: If ''Mystic Shot'' successfully hits an enemy, the {{sti|'''current''' cooldowns}} of '''Ezreal's''' abilities, including ''Mystic Shot's'', are reduced by {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
